interface.shortDescription: Software architecture audits and staged refactoring.
interface.longDescription: Software architecture audits and decisions use source evidence to evaluate code boundaries, AI-assisted code architecture, ownership/runtime topology, async state consistency, conformance, ADRs, fitness functions, structure metrics, and staged refactoring. Coding agents can assist architecture recovery, design-option comparison, incremental refactoring, and source-grounded patch review, while dependency direction, public APIs, domain/data seams, runtime coupling, quality attributes, policy checks, cycles, and before/after proof remain the architectural subject.
capabilities: Ownership topology, CODEOWNERS/OWNERS coverage, and cross-owned coordination risk
Runtime topology, deployment, observability, and resilience review
AI-assisted code architecture recovery, design-option comparison, incremental refactoring, and source-grounded patch review
Async state, invalidation, replay, caller-outcome, and race consistency review
Structure metrics for coupling, instability, and dependency cycles
Architecture decision record creation and review
Architecture risk, reversibility, and blast-radius scoring
defaultPrompt: Use Architecture Intelligence to audit this codebase architecture from source evidence.
